zollverein.name: Zollverein
zollverein.description: A customs union formed to abolish tariff barriers and unify economic territory.

economic_nationalism.name: Economic Nationalism
economic_nationalism.description: The ideology linking economic interests and market unification to national identity.

conservatism.name: Conservatism
conservatism.description: A political philosophy advocating for the preservation of traditional institutions like monarchy and the Church.

modernisation.name: Modernisation
modernisation.description: The process of adopting efficient bureaucracy, modern armies, and dynamic economies to strengthen state power.

feudalism.name: Feudalism
feudalism.description: A traditional social and economic structure characterized by serfdom and hierarchical land ownership.

railways.name: Railways
railways.description: Infrastructure network used to stimulate mobility and economic integration.

nation_building.name: Nation-building
nation_building.description: The process of constructing or structuring a national identity using cultural and linguistic tools.

vernacular_language.name: Vernacular language
vernacular_language.description: The native language used by the common people to foster national sentiment.

nationalist_symbols.name: Nationalist symbols
nationalist_symbols.description: Cultural elements like music and dance used to represent national identity and resistance.

industrialisation.name: Industrialisation
industrialisation.description: The development of industries in a region or country on a wide scale.

feudal_dues.name: Feudal dues
feudal_dues.description: Economic obligations imposed on peasants by the aristocracy.

textile_production.name: Textile production
textile_production.description: The manufacturing process of cloth, often transitioning from home-based to machine-based.

nationalism.name: Nationalism
nationalism.description: A political ideology centered on the nation-state and national identity.

liberal_ideology.name: Liberal Ideology
liberal_ideology.description: A system of ideas reflecting social and political visions, often associated with democracy and parliamentary governance.

nation_state.name: Nation-state
nation_state.description: A sovereign state whose citizens or subjects are relatively homogeneous in factors such as language or common descent.

prussian_army.name: Prussian Army
prussian_army.description: The military force of Prussia that played a central role in German unification.

german_empire.name: German Empire
german_empire.description: The unified German state established in 1871 under Prussian leadership.

bureaucracy.name: Bureaucracy
bureaucracy.description: The administrative system used to manage state affairs and support political unification.
